name: Navsari
registryAssessment: Navsari district's official land-records procedure identifies the district administration as custodian for the local service and directs users to Gujarat's AnyRoR portal; the Gujarat Revenue Department identifies the Settlement Commissioner and Superintendent of Land Records and city-survey functions. A Navsari-specific DILRMP cadastral-status page and an official NAKSHA report naming Navsari as an approved urban pilot were also found. This establishes registry/service provenance, but not open parcel-vector integration.

queries.query: Navsari Gujarat official cadastral parcel map land records Bhu Naksha survey map
queries.result: Found the official Navsari district Land Records page linking AnyRoR, the Navsari-specific DILRMP Map Digitization/Geo-Referenced/ULPIN status page, Gujarat Revenue Department land-record and city-survey functions, and an official NAKSHA report naming Navsari among Gujarat's approved urban pilots. No public anonymous parcel-vector endpoint was exposed by discovery.

officialSources.observation: States that Gujarat land records are online, identifies mamlatdar/prant/collector offices for mutations, and links AnyRoR; page fetched successfully.

officialSources.observation: Gujarati page identifies the land-record service and describes lookup inputs including survey, khata and entry numbers; fetched through discovery.

officialSources.role: Government of India DILRMP Navsari district status
officialSources.observation: Search result is explicitly scoped to State Gujarat and District Navsari and presents cadastral-map, parcel and ULPIN status fields; direct open returned an internal error in the web client, so no numeric status was copied.

officialSources.role: Gujarat Revenue Department / land-record custodian reference
officialSources.observation: Official page assigns survey, settlement and city-survey matters to the Revenue Department and links AnyRoR, property cards, and the Settlement Commissioner/Superintendent of Land Records.
Report states that Gujarat's approved NAKSHA urban local bodies include Navsari and describes Map-1/Map-2/Map-3 workflow; this is programme provenance, not proof of a public parcel API.

Referenced by the Navsari district page and Gujarat Revenue Department; anonymous HTTPS and HTTP requests timed out during this attempt, so no viewer configuration, schema, CRS, ID, or geometry was obtained.

geometryDecision.reason: No safe native parcel ID plus full polygon was obtained from an anonymous public response. The exact WUP point was preserved and was not shifted; service timeout and absent public endpoint evidence do not establish citywide absence.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Navsari district land-record procedure, Gujarat Revenue Department custodians, DILRMP Navsari status, and NAKSHA Navsari pilot references.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Official service and custodian provenance was established, but anonymous parcel-vector access, schema, CRS, native identity, exact-point containment, and citywide coverage were not verified.
